en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: 456- Ahmad ibn Ali al-Razi, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Muqri', from al-Muqani'i, from Bakkar, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad, from Ja'far ibn Sa'eed al-Asadi, from (his father), from Abu Abdullah (AS),
he said: "In the year of the conquest, the Euphrates will split until it enters the streets of Kufa."
